The larger aggregate delta includes run variance in unchanged library shapes.

Build, kernelguard, and all 39 official tests pass at every committed variant. Final-SHA nsys profiles cover all custom sizes: n32 fused/classifier=59.699/4.018 us; n176 reducer/solve=467.928/394.110 us; n352 fused reducer+couplings/panel QR/block-four backtransform/Sturm/inverse=3622.789/1249.076/814.020/152.311/91.779 us; n512 clustered prefix/serial tail/solve=2.948/52.197/18.928 ms. Keep exploring the measured openings: extend the cooperative n352 prefix beyond 32 columns so the second CTA contributes before the coupling epilogue, emit each six-term coupling group while its four reflectors are cache-hot, remove or fuse the 1.249 ms panel QR, or test exact block-eight grouping while retaining the same stress certificate.
